links.title: Data and APIs in JavaScript Track
links.description: This course is for aspiring developers who want to learn how to work with data in web applications. How do you retrieve, collect, and store data? You’ll learn by creating three data projects. The first is client-side only and explores how to load data with fetch() and present it on a web page. Viewers will learn about handling asynchronous events with Promises and how to render data to the DOM as well as draw to HTML5 canvas with p5.js. The second and third projects will introduce "full stack" development adding server-side programming with Node.js for data persistence and API authentication.
